text_block_list.text:
One day, a gust of wind blew away some 
important documents, and as I desperately 
chased after them……

Failing to notice the slope, I lost my 
footing and took a massive tumble straight 
into the brush……

Spilling a drink and having to redo 
paperwork, forgetting things, tripping 
over nothing... Lately, it's just been one 
bad break after another.

Fortunately, I managed to recover the 
documents just before falling, but 
exhaustion washed over me, and I lacked 
the will to get up. Sighing at how 
pathetic that was for a grown adult...
Hyaah!

Startled by the huge impact, I sat up, 
only to find Rhein Kraft sprawled out next 
to me for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! This feels amazing~! It's like 
diving straight into the sunshine!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I love sunbathing, so I've had my eye 
on this grassy patch for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And then I saw you dive right in, Trainer, 
so I just couldn't help myself...
choice_data_list: It's not like I dove right into it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um...? I'm sorry, was I interrupting 
something?
choice_data_list: Ah, no... don't worry about it.
Ah, no... don't worry about it.

text_block_list.text:
She just hopped in because she loves 
basking in the sun. I shouldn't say 
anything tactless and ruin the mood for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaale, exhaaale... Fufu, I feel warm 
all the way down to my heart~...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you give it a try too, Trainer? 
It feels really good.

Since the chance presented itself, I 
decided to follow Rhein Kraft's lead...

The scent of grass and enveloping warmth 
felt so comforting, lightening my heavy 
spirits in an instant. It's quite a 
wonderful way to relax.
choice_data_list:
(Falling down wasn't so bad after all, I 
suppose.)
(Falling down wasn't all bad, I guess.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaale, exhaaale... Inhaaale, 
exhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... exhaaale... Zzz... mmmnyah...

However, past the point of relaxation, I 
started getting sleepy...

The submission deadline for the documents 
is tomorrow. I don't have to turn them in 
today to make it in time, but... what 
should I do?
choice_data_list:
(Force myself to get up with all my 
might!)
(Take it easy for just a bit longer.)

text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow has its own schedule. As 
expected, I should finish submitting these 
documents today.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *mumble*...? Trainer, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Maybe I relaxed too much. I 
totally forgot I was in the middle of a 
run.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm sleepy, but time to pump myself up! 
All... right... hup...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Good thing I didn't accidentally 
doze off. I'm heading back out to finish 
my run!

Rhein Kraft ran off with light, airy 
strides.

There was still time before the reception 
counter closed. Deciding to take it easy 
for just a little longer, I let my body 
relax and closed my eyes……

Before I knew it, evening had fully 
settled in...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...! I came out for a run, and I fell 
completely asleep!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, maybe getting plenty of sleep did 
the trick? I feel ready to give it my all 
in tomorrow's training.
choice_data_list:
I feel ready to give it my all again 
starting tomorrow.

I feel like I can give it my all again 
starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... If that's the case, I'm glad.

Today's schedule got pushed to tomorrow. 
It's going to be busy, but my heart feels 
strangely light. I suppose I have her warm 
presence to thank for that.
